description:
#In addition to the public sails listed on this site, the Schooner Adirondack III is available for Private Charter!

You and up to 41 other guests can have her all to yourselves for a private sailing excursion in Boston Harbor.

She is quite popular for corporate outings, team-builders, birthdays, anniversaries, wedding parties, and family and alumni reunions.

Full catering and bar options are available.

She sails from Rowes Wharf.

##Classic Harbor Line

Classic Harbor Line’s Adirondack III features teak decks, mahogany-trimmings, and just under 2,000 square feet of canvas to escort you through Boston’s historic harbor!

Though it is a light and lively sailing vessel, it is also quite comfortable, with ample deck space and seating for up to 42. It was designed and built by Scarano Boat Building of Albany, NY for taking groups of people on spectacular sightseeing adventures. 

Sailing in this schooner is a delight. She moves through the water efficiently and beautifully; we take great pride in sharing her with you. 

The Adirondack III is operated by Coast Guard-certified captains and an extremely friendly and talented crew. Our crew is known for their amazing hospitality, and are professionally trained and experienced in sailing our vessels well and safely. Do not hesitate to ask our crew about the boat or any of the Boston sites.

disclaimers:
##Activity takes place rain or shine, but within reason
For schooner sailing excursions, a captain-authorized cancellation or delay may be issued up until departure time if the weather is deemed too threatening to the safety or enjoyment of the experience. Extreme high winds, fog, torrential rain, extremely low temperatures, etc. may all contribute to a cancellation decision.
faqs:
**Is there parking and how much is it?**
>Limited metered parking can be found around Rowes Wharf. Regular daily rate at the Hotel is $36, but after 5:00 pm on weekdays and anytime on weekends, the rate is $12 with our validation.

**What are the rates to charter the boat?**
>Rates are posted on our website on the private charters page. Go to www.boston-sailing.com and select private charters.

**Is smoking permitted during the sail?**
>No, smoking is not permitted anywhere on the boat.
